description: Source code for the Point of Sale module in an OpenERP/Odoo system, defining models for POS orders, order lines, payments, and related reports, including business logic for order processing, invoicing, and accounting entries.

classes.name: pos_order
classes.description: Main model representing a POS order, including order lines, payments, invoicing, and accounting logic.

classes.name: pos_order_line
classes.description: Model for individual lines within a POS order, including product, quantity, and pricing.

classes.name: pos_payment
classes.description: Model for payments associated with POS orders.

classes.name: report_transaction_pos
classes.description: Database view model for POS transaction reporting.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes POS orders if they are in draft state.

methods.name: onchange_partner_pricelist
methods.description: Updates the pricelist based on selected partner.

methods.name: _amount_total
methods.description: Calculates total amount for an order, including tax adjustments.

methods.name: _amount_tax
methods.description: Calculates total tax for an order.

methods.name: _total_payment
methods.description: Calculates total payments made for an order.

methods.name: _total_return
methods.description: Calculates total returned amount for an order.

methods.name: payment_get
methods.description: Retrieves payment IDs associated with an order.

methods.name: _sale_journal_get
methods.description: Gets default sale journal.

methods.name: _receivable_get
methods.description: Gets default receivable account.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Duplicates a POS order with default values.

methods.name: test_order_lines
methods.description: Validates presence of order lines before processing.

methods.name: dummy_button
methods.description: Placeholder method, always returns True.

methods.name: test_paid
methods.description: Checks if order is fully paid.

methods.name: _get_qty_differences
methods.description: Detects changes in product quantities between original and modified pickings.

methods.name: _split_picking
methods.description: Splits stock pickings if product quantities are changed.

methods.name: create_picking
methods.description: Creates and confirms stock pickings for orders.

methods.name: set_to_draft
methods.description: Resets order state to draft and recreates workflow.

methods.name: cancel_order
methods.description: Cancels an order by creating an inverted picking and reverting moves.

methods.name: add_payment
methods.description: Adds a payment to an order.

methods.name: add_product
methods.description: Adds a product line to an order.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Creates a refund copy of an order with negative quantities.

methods.name: invoice_action_done
methods.description: Creates and validates invoice for a paid order.

methods.name: action_invoice
methods.description: Generates invoice from order lines.

methods.name: create_account_move
methods.description: Creates accounting entries for an order, including taxes and payments.

methods.name: action_paid
methods.description: Marks order as paid and creates pickings.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels an order and associated pickings.

methods.name: action_done
methods.description: Finalizes order by creating accounting entries.
